name: Urgent payment instruction or payment-detail change outside normal process
description: Staff receive urgent, confidential requests, or changes to beneficiary details, directing payment to a new beneficiary outside normal workflow.
fp: Genuine urgent business payments and supplier bank changes occur; verify via a known channel.
